title: Backend Engineering Intern
raw_text: NovaPay is seeking a Backend Engineering Intern. Responsibilities: Design and implement high-performance RESTful APIs using Python frameworks. Proficiency in SQL query optimization and relational schema design. Write automated unit and integration tests with pytest. Experience deploying applications with Docker and container workflows.
